updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is consolidating all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint classifiers, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This streamlines classifier administration and reduces fragmentation across the compliance platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Protection for Excluded Windows Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding coverage to protect sensitive data in commonly excluded Windows folders such as Temp and AppData, which previously fell outside protection scope. This enhancement reduces blind spots in data protection by monitoring high-risk storage locations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance – Enhanced Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Communication Compliance policies now support external email detection, OR logic for combining multiple conditions, and pre-deployment condition testing. These enhancements enable more granular and flexible compliance rule design tailored to organizational requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection action data to SQL tables, enabling compliance teams to build custom reports on repository scanning results. This provides deeper visibility into classification and protection patterns across scanned sources.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management is adding hard delete capability through secure priority cleanup workflows for OneDrive and SharePoint, enabling compliance admins to permanently remove content beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. This addresses strict compliance deletion requirements while maintaining safeguards against inadvertent data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Scoped to Teams Only
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams that currently apply to Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer governing Copilot workloads. This change clarifies policy scope and prevents unintended retention rule application to Copilot data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides general availability support for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols with enforcement of restrictive actions. This closes a critical protection gap for file transfer methods commonly used in compliance-sensitive workflows.
